newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-BITTER KAREMBEU TO STAY AT SAMPDORIA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BITTER KAREMBEU TO STAY AT SAMPDORIA.

text.p: Sampdoria's French midfielder Christian Karembeu, who wanted to join Real Madrid while his Italian club pursued a deal with Spanish rivals Barcelona, is staying in serie A after all.
The Italian news agency ANSA reported on Wednesday the unhappy New Caledonian-born French international had given a final 'No' to a move to Barcelona.
It said top officials from Barcelona and Sampdoria had met Karembeu in Monte Carlo on Tuesday to resolve the matter.

Karembeu repeated his desire to move to Real, coached by former AC Milan coach Fabio Capello, but Sampdoria had already signed an agreement with Barcelona preventing the player from leaving them for any other club.
"Its been done out of spite, so now I'm a prisoner of Sampdoria," the player, who has agreed verbally to join Real, was quoted as saying.
Karembeu, whose contract with the Genoa club expires in 1998, said two teams currently playing in Europe were interested in signing him up to the expiry of his Italian contract.
"Now everything has blown up," he said.
Karembeu has been photographed recently wearing the team shirts of both Barcelona and Real Madrid and he has admitted that his affairs are "in a bit of a mess".
